checks.name: fmt
checks.command: sh -c 'cargo fmt --all --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --all --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -- --check'

checks.name: check
checks.command: sh -c 'cargo check --workspace --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml && cargo check --workspace --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml'

checks.name: clippy
checks.command: sh -c 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings'

checks.name: focused-tests
checks.command: sh -c 'cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-human --lib && cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-human --test human_harness && cargo test --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -p academy-body --lib && cargo test --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -p academy-body --test body_course generated_course_preserves_first_failure_instead_of_teaching_around_it'
